title: Headless TTW Not of This World (DLC05MZ1): from the alien signal through the abduction, Somah's staged fight and Sally's help to the engine core's cryo lab (stage 200, quest completed)

actions.text: Given: the player is out of Vault 101 in the Capital Wasteland, Following in His Footsteps (MQ01) at its first stage (10), and Enclave Radio on the air (CG04's sun-blind trigger at the vault door enables RadioEnclaveREF [observed]). DLC05MZ1 runs from the start; its script (DLC05MZ1QuestScript [observed]) counts 60 s once the Enclave signal is on, then shows the strange signal's message and sets 10 (the alien radio beacon enabled).

Travel stand-in: following the signal to the crashed alien craft by the alien radio beacon; within 1000 units the abduction begins: the beam, the player's gear taken into DLC05PlayerContainerREF, the examination scene on the mothership, then the holding cell, where Somah speaks to the player [observed: DLC05MZ1QuestScript].

Path: Somah's talk in the holding cells (DLC05MZ1SomahGreet1, Talk1: the claw takes a prisoner; then Talk1, Advantage1, Plan1, Fight1, FightB4, FightC1: the staged fight, DLC05MZ1Fight 1), the guard drawn in and both guards killed (30), the player's gear from DLC05PlayerContainerREF and the two holding-cell aliens killed (35), Sally's cell (DLC05SallyCellTriggerScript: her plea, 40), Sally's help with the inner door (SallyGreet1, then SallyGreetC1: 50), and Sally's way through the engine core to the cryo lab (SallyCoreUpdate 1 to 3, DLC05MZ1SallyCryoTubesGoodbye: 200, Among the Stars started) [observed].
Talk1's first answer ends the talk while the claw carries a prisoner off (ClawFlag: a 20 s count); then Somah talks again.

Stand-in for the guard's walk to the cell at the noise (the AI's): put at DLC05MZ1AlienGuard1Marker; within 50 units the script has him speak (his line's end: DLC05MZ1Fight 3, the cell opened, the guards hostile), and Somah's attack line sets 6 [observed].
The fight: both guards killed; with both dead Somah's post-fight line ends with 30 (the gear's container not yet opened) [observed].
The player's gear (DLC05PlayerContainerREF: its OnActivate completes objective 30) taken back; the holding-cell aliens (DLC05MZ1AlienHCMelee1, 2) killed: the script sets 35 [observed].
Travel stand-in: along the cells to Sally's; its trigger (DLC05SallyCellTriggerScript) has her ask to be let out (her line's end: 40) [observed].

Stand-in for Sally's walk to the wires by the holding cells' inner door and her work at them (her package; the script waits for her GetSitting 2): SallyDoor is set to 3 as that step sets it (Sally put at DLC05MZ1SallyDoorMoveMarker, a 10 s count); then the door opens for her (SallyDoor 4) [observed: DLC05MZ1QuestScript].

actions.label: sally: told you I could help
milestone: DLC05MZ1 50, to the engine core

actions.text: Travel stand-in: with Sally through the steamworks to the engine core, Sally ahead (the AI's follow and guide packages). Her walks are stand-ins: into the core's trigger (DLC05MZ1SallyCoreTriggerScript: SallyCoreUpdate 1), to the teleporter marker, to the end marker; at each the player talks to her (her greetings set SallyCoreUpdate 2, then 3) [observed].

actions.label: sally: I'll show you what I found
